top_signals.title: EU Moves to Fast-Track Renewables as Oil Import Costs Soar
top_signals.summary: The European Parliament has reached a provisional agreement for accelerated permit issuance for new energy projects with a focus on wind, solar, grid upgrades, and storage, Reuters has reported, citing the EU Council. Under the terms of the agreement with the EP, member states of the European Union would be able to fast-track new wind and solar developments by categorizing them as being in the overriding public interest.
